title: Tool — timeline entry

fields.label: Start date
fields.name: start_date
fields.instructions: When this tool entered the practice. Day is optional — pick the 1st of the month if unknown.

fields.label: Sunset date
fields.name: sunset_date
fields.instructions: When this tool stopped being used for new work — kept on only to maintain existing/legacy projects. Leave blank if never sunsetted (still fully current, or went straight to Ended).

fields.label: End date
fields.name: end_date
fields.instructions: When this tool was dropped entirely — no longer used on any project, including legacy ones. Leave blank if still current or only sunsetting.

description: Bain Design — tools timeline entry fields. Post title is the tool name, post content/excerpt is the note describing why it mattered.
